subject: computer vision project
text:
Hi [NAME],

I came across your work on 3D and computer vision at Lucid. Thought I'd
reach out since we work with a lot of CV/ML teams on annotation projects
when inhouse tools start to hit limits with scaling data and edge cases.

Teams use Encord for native video annotation and multimodal support (image,
video, 3D point cloud), along with model-assisted pre-labeling,
multi-camera/sensor syncing, and automated QA - areas I imagine might
resonate with your work.

Quick context: we're a data development platform for advanced CV,
supporting 200+ AI teams like Boston Dynamics, Woven by Toyota, LVT,
Thinking Machines Labs to streamline data pipelines and boost model
accuracy.

Would love your quick take on what we've built - do you have 30min next
Tue-Thu PT?

subject: [NAME] - computer vision
text:

at [COMPANY]? We're flexible morning times MT next week.

subject: Re: model quality and deployment speed
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've been working with Retrocausal's team to tackle similar challenges I'd
imagine Invisible faces i.e. keeping model quality high while moving fast
on new use cases.

model evaluation, verifying data faster, ensuring consistency across
annotators, and comparing new datasets to prior model outputs. It's helped
them ship improvements quicker without exposing customer data to third
parties.

customer data, I thought it might be worth sharing how they've built
secure, internal pipelines using Encord.

Would you be open to a short intro call next week? I'm free Mon-Wed after 2
pm PT.
